summary: Owner-only regression of COPY/PASTE flows, VIN follow-through across Charts/Chat, and the Active Vehicle dropdown fix. Backend: 7/7 pytest assertions passed against /app/backend/tests/test_regression_charts_chat.py (login, vehicles count=8, no blank, Tahoe present, VIN decode, chart/edit table_text_out, letter HTML). Frontend Playwright: chart-vehicle and vehicle-select both list the same 8 vehicles with Tahoe at TOP and zero undefined entries; AppContext single-source-of-truth verified end-to-end (Charts→Chat→Charts switch propagates correctly); VIN-pull modal decodes 1GNSKBKC7GR197364 to 2016 Chevrolet Tahoe; chart LOAD EXAMPLE→APPLY CHANGES→COPY copies a 306-char tab-separated table to clipboard; Letter page renders pre#letter and the orange TAP TO COPY button works.

ui_bugs.issue: SEND button is missing data-testid="chat-send". Playwright had to fall back to button:has-text("SEND"). Add data-testid for test stability.

integration_issues.issue: Could not independently verify the copy-table-btn click→'✓ COPIED' flow. With Tahoe active, the prompt 'paste me a 5x5 spark table … pure data only inside a code block' returned a guardrail reply (4 pre-flight clarification questions) instead of a fenced code block, so renderRichContent never instantiated CopyableBlock. The component code path exists; this is an LLM behaviour observation, not a code bug. To regression-test deterministically, either (a) seed a chat reply with a ``` fenced block, or (b) tune the system prompt so 'pure data only inside a code block' bypasses the pre-flight checklist.

issues: Spec wanted post-click button text '✓ COPIED — NOW PASTE IT', actual is 'TAP TO COPY AGAIN'. Visual feedback still confirms copy succeeded; flag only as a copy-text deviation from PRD.

vin-bar-active text concatenates label + 'VIN' button label with no whitespace ('2016 CHEVROLET Tahoe LTVIN' in innerText). Visually separated, but innerText scrape shows them joined — minor a11y hint.

action_items: (LOW) Add data-testid="chat-send" to the Chat SEND button.
(LOW / product) Confirm desired letter-page post-click copy: spec says '✓ COPIED — NOW PASTE IT'; current is 'TAP TO COPY AGAIN'.

(Optional) Consider tightening the WRENCH system prompt so explicit requests with 'pure data only inside a code block' skip the 4-question pre-flight and emit a fenced block immediately — would also enable a deterministic regression test for CopyableBlock.
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext single-source-of-truth refactor is solid: selecting a vehicle on either Charts or Chat propagates to the other immediately on next mount. localStorage('dw_active_vehicle') persists across reloads.
Backend GET /api/vehicles auto-cleanup confirmed: blank-year/make/model/vin rows are gone, count is exactly 8.
Tahoe (1GNSKBKC7GR197364) renders at the TOP of both dropdowns (newest-first ordering) — good UX after the fix.
VIN modal opens via data-testid="vin-bar-add" (when no active vehicle) or vin-bar-switch (when one is set). NHTSA decode returns within ~3s and surfaces 2016/CHEVROLET/Tahoe in the modal.

Chart /api/chart/edit response field is table_text_out (matches frontend); copy-result button copies 306 chars containing both tabs and newlines — clipboard verified via navigator.clipboard.readText().

success_rate.frontend: 95% (1 sub-flow — CopyableBlock click — could not be triggered because LLM returned a pre-flight reply instead of a fenced block; all other flows green)

seed_data_creation: None. No vehicles created or deleted. Two short chat messages were sent to the Tahoe session for the CopyableBlock test; safe to leave in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run /app/backend/tests/test_regression_charts_chat.py first (~3s, 7 tests). Vehicles are expected to be exactly 8 with Tahoe (1GNSKBKC7GR197364) at the top. /api/chart/edit takes body { table_text, instruction } — NOT table_text_in. To re-test the chat CopyableBlock, send a prompt that bypasses the pre-flight checklist (e.g. 'NO pre-flight, just dump a 5x5 spark sample, mock data ok, fenced block').
rca_of_the_issue: No real bug found in the AppContext refactor or the auto-cleanup logic. The single observable miss vs. PRD is the chat CopyableBlock click — root cause is the LLM safety prompt returning clarification questions rather than a code block; the React component (Chat.jsx renderRichContent + CopyableBlock) is wired correctly. One test-script issue fixed during this run: /api/chart/edit field name is `table_text` not `table_text_in`.
